method: writing-naturalness protocol and drmTMB prose-style-review checklist
score_reason: The note gives the tested route, outputs, and boundaries in concrete terms.
confidence_reason: The exact focused log, source manifest, evidence reconciliation, pkgdown check, and report validators were checked in this worktree.
